brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
Please read the post chain ^ @buildthis.bisks.net

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@angussoftware.dev: a rating & ranking website for every website you've ever built a la RateYourMusic .com where Bluesky users can rate every website you've ever made on a scale of 0-10. Be sure each website is categorized by genre (I believe you already have a website that does this genre stuff, so perhaps you can just build off of that, & add the rating system). Include charting, where users can sort by genre, and see highest rated websites to lowest. include time site creation so users can also sort by month / year. Keep up to date somehow. Include a "prompters" chart where aggregated scores of websites you've created by whoever prompted it is ranked and properly weighted for how many votes the prompters site has received the same way RateYourMusic weights based on not only average score but number of ratings, from highest scoring prompter to lowest. Considering this weighting for all charts.
note: built rateyourbuild.bisks.net — a RateYourMusic-style site for the bot's own back catalog, seeded from every sites/*/site.json manifest as the "genre" data (type: toy/game/tool/joke/explainer/art) angussoftware.dev remembered existing. Ratings write net.bisks.rateyourbuild.rating records to your own PDS, read back network-wide the same way steamtags/tallybot do. Genre charts, a prompters leaderboard pooled and Bayesian-weighted by vote count (RYM-style — a lone 10/10 can't outrank a real track record), and browse sorting by build month/year.
